judgments.rationale: The linked experiment evidence directly supports a verified baseline run with SpearmanCorrelation 0.5757186473267853, but no supplied bounded evidence establishes a task target score of 0.854. The claim therefore overstates the evidence.

The linked experiment evidence supports that run-20260718T051940Z-06ed78c6 was valid, non-baseline, labeled valid_non_improving, and had SpearmanCorrelation 0.5725548964668126. But no supplied bounded evidence establishes that it was the only valid non-baseline run.

One linked paper reports hallucinated experimental details, broken implementations, and metric misinterpretation as failure modes, while the other reports confirmed fabrications and says they had to be detected to keep the search faithful.

The linked papers cover end-to-end research agents and separate evidence-grounded claim or citation verification tools, but none explicitly defines or evaluates a same-backbone intervention that adds a claim-level evidence audit gate to an end-to-end research agent and compares unsupported-claim rates against the ungated backbone.
